organization.discoveryNotes: Logistics lighthouse template: multi-branch dispatch, warehouse/inventory movement, fleet coordination, and advisory security baseline. Staging-validated operating model — not a live customer claim.

workflows.name: Delivery request intake and dispatch assignment
workflows.description: Customer or internal delivery request captured; dispatcher assigns route and driver (operator-managed).

workflows.name: Warehouse receiving and inventory movement
workflows.description: GRN capture, stock movement, and adjustment review with approval trail.

workflows.name: Delivery exception and proof-of-delivery review
workflows.description: Exception or dispute routed to compliance owner with evidence readiness (advisory).

workflows.name: Supplier purchase request
workflows.description: Procurement submits supplier request; finance coordination before approval.

workflows.name: Monthly logistics performance review
workflows.description: Operations and finance review SLA, cost, and open exceptions.

securityRequirements.requirement: MFA for admin, dispatcher, and tenant-admin accounts
Audit logging on dispatch assignment and shipment status changes
Role-based access to customer PII in CRM
Branch-scoped access for warehouse and fleet roles
Advisory identity and access alignment (operator-managed policy)

integrations.notes: Corporate SSO readiness for HQ and hub staff (operator-managed)
Future telematics integration — not active in this phase
Future carrier API — not active in this phase

experienceRequirements.requirement: KPI dashboard: on-time delivery, fleet utilization, open incidents
Branch ops view with approvals queue and exception workload
Mobile-first dispatch list; minimal navigation; large touch targets
Reporting readiness and trend views — not frontline mobile UI

identity.ssoNotes: Logistics template: Entra ID readiness for HQ/hub; MFA recommended for admins and dispatchers (operator policy).

security.complianceNotes: Fleet and customer data handling subject to operator policy; segment warehouse vs CRM access. Advisory CyberCrow posture only.
